description: Implementation of CustomerOptionSetDao interface for accessing CustomerOptionSet data with JPA queries, including methods for retrieving CustomerOptionSet entities by ID, option ID, option value ID, and listing by store and language.

classes.name: CustomerOptionSetDaoImpl
classes.description: Data Access Object implementation for CustomerOptionSet entities, using QueryDSL for building type-safe queries.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOptionSet by its unique ID, including associated customer options and values.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet entities associated with a specific CustomerOption ID within a MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet entities associated with a specific CustomerOptionValue ID within a MerchantStore.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all CustomerOptionSet entities for a specified MerchantStore and Language, ordered by sort order.
